scope: Index of existing focused-attempt receipts, genuine logs, and saved source snapshots; not a rerun, full-gate outcome, or publication-success receipt.

method.attempt_identity: Flat receipt basename or containing attempt-directory basename; multiple layouts for the same identity are combined, not double-counted.
method.observed_file_hashes: Computed from the files present at indexing time. Saved source snapshots are never substituted with current source files.
method.outcome: Derived from the recorded process exit_code, retaining the original status separately.
method.source_snapshot_association: Actual attempt/source/ subtree, or an existing sibling .lean file with the same basename as a flat receipt. Recorded source hashes without a snapshot remain explicitly separate.

limitations: Some actual attempts have no saved source snapshot; the index records absence and does not reconstruct or substitute source bytes.
Some receipts lack original source/log digests or timestamps; absent fields remain null.
